name: apg-upgrader
body: A person who upgrades an existing apg installation by re-running `apg init` on a repo that already has a `.opencode/agents/` directory. When the suite starts distributing a file their repo already has (the newly-distributed `implementation-phase-reviewer.md`), `apg init` warns about the duplicate but never deletes; they need an explicit, findable instruction telling them to remove their local copy by hand, so the warning is a migration prompt rather than an unexplained nuisance.
